path_adaptation: The original algorithms and reporting scripts are byte-for-byte copies. code/package_runtime.py supplies code/data/results locations at import time; the public reproduce.py protects frozen results and directs every generated file to a separate output directory. Historical src/ paths in results/manifest.json map to code/ for included files; old diagnostic modules that are not needed by the experiment are intentionally excluded. The portable execution manifest hashes only the included dependency set and has a separate definition fingerprint. Shared Chinese font: ../fonts/simsun.ttc; a --font argument can supply a font if Q3 is moved alone.
